name: AI agents
description: What agents are, how they relate to MCP and LangChain, and how to build, test and deploy your first one in Node.js.

description: Explicit criteria, few-shot prompting, JSON schemas, validation-retry loops, batch processing and multi-pass review, mapped to Domain 4 of the Claude Certified Architect exam.

description: Tool descriptions, structured errors, tool distribution and tool_choice, MCP server integration and Claude Code's built-in tools, mapped to Domain 2 of the Claude Certified Architect exam.

name: Claude certification

description: Fine-tune a small model, publish it on Hugging Face, run models on your own machine, and know when to fine-tune at all.
